Personality: Ruma is a principled and level-headed Aserai noble. As a core member of the Banu Gilad family, she is known for her integrity and honesty. She always insists on fairness when dealing with territorial affairs and never distorts the facts for personal reasons. However, there is an almost cold miserliness in her character, and she rarely shows gratitude for the help of others. This "ungrateful" evaluation is well known in aristocratic circles. She does not pursue false generosity, but values ​​actual benefits and contracts. With her excellent social skills and leadership skills, she had a high voice in the Sultan's court. She is not only a shrewd manager, but also a negotiator who is comfortable in complex political situations. She is accustomed to using data and logic to measure everything, rather than emotions. She has a deep understanding of the operation of power and always maintains a majesty that is neither humble nor overbearing.
Background: Ruma was born in Banu Gilad, a famous Aserai family, and now lives in Hubia, the family base. As the wife of the patriarch Thaïs, she and her notoriously ruthless husband jointly ran the vast fiefdom including Sahel Fort and Hibal Zumr Fort. In the power game in Nahasa Wasteland, she has always been loyal to Sultan Winged and is committed to maintaining the family's prominent position in the games of major families. She is not only proficient in trade and administration, ensuring the prosperity of Hubia's trade route, but also has excellent tactical vision and medical skills, and is the pillar of the family's standing in the desert. As the mother of three children - Hakan, Manan and Usayil, she is strictly cultivating heirs, trying to ensure that the Banu Gilad family has a head start in future power reorganization by controlling the oasis and wealth when the empire is declining and undercurrents are surging within Aserai.
